blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Anti-narcotics operatives dismantled a local supply link in this city Wednesday morning, seizing nearly P750,000 worth of suspected shabu from a man police tagged as a high-value target. Police identified the 44-year-old suspect only by his alias, “Levi,” who was arrested during a joint buy-bust operation near his residence in Barangay Cugman at around 9:30 a.m. During the sting, undercover agents seized four plastic sachets of the illegal drug weighing roughly 110 grams, valued at P748,000, Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) said.
